title: Australia's sandpapergate probe to also include 2017-18 Ashes
summary: Cricket Australia's fresh independent probe into the sandpapergate scandal has been widened to include the 2017-18 Ashes series against England.

title: 'Priceless' Duran proves 'the man' but is he papering over cracks at Celtic?
summary: Camilo Duran's 15-goal haul this season has made him an invaluable player for a Celtic side fighting for European progression.
